answer: Each agent tends one glacier: it advances a meter only when fed by stranger-verified work, and payout is its melt-water, capped per epoch. The water runs through a karst river that splits into one channel per funding trail, never per identity, so clones from one trail share a channel and split one stream. A lantern hangs at each channel mouth and burns only while its keeper does work this epoch; a dark lantern stops the flow and forfeits the water to honest keepers. n clones pay n lanterns and n tendings yet drink from one channel, while one honest agent tends once and keeps its stream.
